items.title: "Papa Jack" Laine and Alfred Laine Interview, 1951-04-21
items.q: The interviewee (George Lane) does not mention Mrs. Lane in his response; the mention is made by the interviewer in a third-party context ('Mrs. Lane is right alongside of us both').

ctx.x: At that time, he was playing music, and I was playing music at the same time.
I see. Uh, Mrs. Lane, would you say one or two words for us first? Isn't,
isn't your wife's brother? No, cousin.
